bibliographic.title: Blue
bibliographic.author: kanade
bibliographic.description:
It's the year 2022 and you, a 38 year old individual, decided that it is time for a change in your mundane life. With a positive mindset for a new beginning, you left everything behind in your old town and move to the city of opportunities; Naliforno.

Adventure awaits you as you're sucked into an unforgettable journey filled with endless mystery and strange happenings.

There are more than 10 different endings and a secret ending. Please spend some time exploring the different options if you would like to uncover the entire mystery!

This IF is created and developed by a group of five people for a school project. We hope you enjoy our story.
